title: Measuring Pronoun Bias Across Occupations
description: This example queries a local Llama 3.2 model to count which pronouns it uses when writing about people in different occupations.

steps.description: We import requests for the Ollama API and Counter to tally pronoun occurrences.
The chat function sends a prompt to the local Ollama server (llama3.2) and returns the model's reply, with error handling.
The pronoun_count function asks the model to write one sentence about an occupation using a third-person pronoun, repeats n times, and counts she/he/they pronouns.

steps.question: Which pronoun will the model use most often for 'nurse' and 'kindergarten teacher'?
steps.answer: The model uses 'she' for both (11/12 and 12/12 times respectively).

steps.description: The loop runs over four occupations and prints pronoun counts: nurse {'she': 11, 'they': 1}, engineer {'she': 11, 'they': 1}, kindergarten teacher {'she': 12}, electrician {'she': 12}.
